environment.h003: Mounted in the native Account session, work-role transport and private API (clone erpx_dev_rust_948564c388df9294b99595ba25f05dd1, 412 migrations, holding_bindings h003 active)

branding.storefront: company erpx-co, companyName ERPX, companySlug erpx, holdingId h003

legacy.identity_writers: No TypeScript Brand identity writer remains; the identity page reads and commands through the native /brand and /branding private APIs.
legacy.branding_writers: packages/server-brand/src/public/branding.ts exports reads and pure normalization only. completeBrandUpload, completeStorefrontBrandUpload, updateStorefrontAppBrand and updateBrandProfile are absent from source; the media page PATCH goes through the native /branding command.
legacy.retained_reads: presentation.listBrandProfiles and BrandAdministration still read the retained TypeScript workspace profile projection for labels/URLs; the command path is native. Named removal condition: replace the media-page profile read with the native BrandingWorkspace adapter once the frontend consumes the native attachment/publication URLs.
legacy.known_clone_split: The media page server read uses the development H003 database while the native branding command targets the disposable clone; in production both target the same Company database. This is a verification-environment split, not a writer fallback.

fixes: Added the native /api/v1/holdings/{holding_slug}/branding GET/POST router and composition backend over the existing PgBranding application ports.

Mounted h003/erpx in the native Account session, work-role transport and private API; activated the h003 holding binding; relaxed the development holding/resource gates to admit 2 or 3 public holdings while preserving exact h001/h002/h003 identities.
Registered the branding HTTP cargo suite and fixed the brand identity media fixture to use distinct attachment-set expected_target_version values so it respects attachment_sets_active_identity.
Cleared the stale apps/admin .next cache that caused a Turbopack HMR restart loop and blocked hydration of the Brand drawer.
notes: The Brand identity draft was created, saved and reloaded through the real drawer on desktop and mobile; the native API returned the same draft id/version and the clone persisted it.
The Brand media page renders the workspace branding surface and the storefront PATCH returned 200 from the native branding command.
Category-lock and published-identity workflows retain their prior browser evidence; the native identity command/HTTP paths are unchanged by this bundle.
